tapChoice: Dis le nom de l'image. Touche l'article qui se place devant ce nom.
tapChoiceWord: Lis le mot. Touche l'article qui se place devant ce mot.
notes: Articles deliberately NOT named: _chips fr is [le, la] but printed K-307 and G1-292 (the sort page) use un/une. Check the fr chips per worksheet — the sort page must show un/une, not le/la.
Reuses printed K-288 wording (Dis le nom de l'image, l'article qui se place devant ce nom); Entoure -> Touche. Tutoiement as on the printed pages.
English source: 'Tap the word that goes in front of it' is ambiguous for a pre-reader — the picture word is also a word. Suggest 'Tap the little word that goes in front of it.'
